title: Launch Audit Report Template
summary: Portfolio demo: before/after security and launch hardening teaching flow with a printable audit checklist — aligns with Fix & launch your app.
problem: Founders shipping AI-generated or rushed apps often do not know what “launch-ready” means until something breaks in production.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo (apps/launch-audit-report). Walks through typical pre-launch checks (headers, auth, env secrets, XSS surfaces) with before/after examples and a printable checklist — educational, not a fake client scorecard. Pairs with my short audit-first Fix & launch service.

zh.title: 上线审计报告模板
zh.summary: 作品集演示：上线前安全与加固的前后对比教学流程 + 可打印审计清单，对应「修复并上线你的应用」。
zh.problem: 用 AI 生成或赶工上线的应用，创始人往往直到生产出问题才意识到什么叫「可以上线」。
zh.solution: 自建作品集演示（apps/launch-audit-report）。逐步展示常见上线前检查（响应头、登录、环境密钥、XSS 面）及前后对比，并提供可打印清单——用于教学，不是虚构客户评分。与先做简短审计再动手的「修复并上线」服务一致。
